value.rationale: Immediate acceptance and deferred acceptance are canonical school-choice mechanisms with a central efficiency-versus-incentives tradeoff. The first finite market where their truthful common-priority outcomes diverge is a natural boundary. The exact if-and-only-if criterion explains the conflict structurally and shows that every divergence is a genuine ordinal welfare tradeoff, not merely a different labeling of the same welfare outcome.
